proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1254 article gives Malayalam kayal string; kayaṟu rope, cord, coir; cakari, cekari, cēri coconut husk and fibres.. The Byari survey form kayarɨ “rope” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
